column1: # Phase 3 milestone J: the random-tick pass's golden run parameters and stream ends.
# NOT a vanilla dump: the pass samples `Level.randValue`, an LCG seeded when the
# level is constructed, so this is a regression pin of this runtime's own output
# rather than a comparison against the game jar. `ctest -R random_tick` replays
# every row below through `tick_chunk_random_blocks` and compares the chunk's
# trace line for line, so a moved draw or a changed draw count cannot land
# reviewing the change first with its `--diff` mode.
# `randStart`/`randEnd` are `BlockRandomPos.value` before and after the whole run:
# a pass that draws once too many or too few ends somewhere else even when the
# samples happen to land on the same cells. `sectionMask` is the per-section
# ticking count the pass was given (bit i = section `minSectionY + i`), which is
# the runner recomputes it from the scene and must agree. `scene` names the
# layout in random_tick_scene.tsv, `samples` is the number of LCG draws taken
# (`popcount(sectionMask) * tickSpeed * ticks`) and `rows` the trace's length.
